result.topic_en: Riemann restricts the definition of the generalized derivatives $\partial^\nu$ to those expansions of $z(x+h)$ in powers of $h$ in which each coefficient is the differential of the preceding one, and argues that a value of the derivative then belongs to only one expansion.
